job.title: (Senior) AI Engineer - Reinforcement Learning Manipulation
job.description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.
Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery

What you’ll be doing Develop cutting-edge reinforcement learning algorithms to enable robust, contact-rich dexterous manipulation, translating vision, depth, tactile, and proprioceptive sensor input into precise end-effector and joint-level motor commands.

 
 Design, test, and refine algorithms to solve complex real-world manipulation challenges, such as handling diverse package form factors, dynamic hand-offs, and operating door handles or latches.

 
 Collaborate with the foundation model team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data. What you must have Strong background in robotic manipulation, including dynamics, grasp synthesis, and trajectory optimization. 

 Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning.

 A minimum of five years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable.

 Strong deep learning fundamentals, including supervised and self-supervised learning techniques, and reinforcement learning, including Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), neural network architectures, policy optimization algorithms, model-based vs. model-free RL, exploration-exploitation strategies, value function methods, transfer learning, domain adaptation, sim-to-real transfer, etc.

 Strong background in robotics including autonomy and/or manipulation.

 Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms.

 Ability to write production-level code in modern C++.

 Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python. Get some bonus points PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience.

 
 Publications at top-tier conferences (e.g., ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS) specifically focusing on robotic manipulation, grasping, or contact-rich RL.

 
 Demonstrated experience working with tactile sensing, multi-fingered robotic hands, or bimanual manipulation.

job.description:
Company Description
At PQ Technologies AG (PQT), we build data processing solutions for the financial industry, working with both structured and unstructured data. Our focus is the End-to-End Compliance & Risk process at banks and financial institutions, in particular Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money-Laundering (AML).
We are a multidisciplinary team of 10–15 people in Zurich, combining deep domain expertise in Compliance & Risk with strong engineering capabilities. Our software runs inside our clients' critical processes at leading financial institutions, tested and relied on daily.
Role Description
We are looking for an intern for a paid, 6-month fixed-term internship, supporting the development of data processing and evaluation systems on top of our Nucleus Compliance & Risk Engine, for leading financial institutions. You'll work closely with our engineers and our Compliance & Risk specialists, and contribute to projects that go live with our clients.
Key responsibilities
Develop (Python) code for data processing and evaluation on our Nucleus Compliance & Risk Engine
Perform data analysis on real datasets in the KYC/AML domain
Support the delivery teams with analysis, testing, documentation and preparation of client sessions
What you will gain
Experience in delivering production-ready code
Practical experience with LLM supported applications in production
Insight into B2B customer communication with regulated financial institutions, and into how client projects are delivered
Direct mentoring from senior engineers and real ownership of your work
Location & commitment
Hybrid — Zurich office, with remote days
Fixed-term internship, 6 months, 70–100%
Start date: 1 September 2026
CHF 4,200 gross per month (paid internship)
No relocation support and no visa sponsorship; travel is limited to occasional client meetings
Extension or permanent role possible after the internship
Qualifications
Currently enrolled in a BSc or MSc in a STEM field at a Swiss university, or a recent graduate
Programming knowledge and experience in Python
A good understanding of algorithms and data structures
Ability to work in a dynamic environment with different types of duties
Valid permission to work in Switzerland
The drive to work independently and pick up new things across different areas
Nice to have — experience working on code collaboratively
No prior compliance or finance knowledge is expected. We care more about attitude and curiosity than a long list of prior experience — we're there to support you, and we're looking for self-starters.
